{{Quote|X-1!|X-1|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''X-1''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Target" /> [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in [[Project Omega]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] made this experiment to create the perfect assassin, who would then go on to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Soresh had their faces surgically altered and wiped their identities from a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] database system. He then started his brutal reconditioning program, which was designed to turn them into mindless servants by removing their past memories and emotions.<ref name="Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref>

At first, X-1 became friends with [[X-2]], [[X-3]], [[X-4]], [[X-5]], [[X-6]], and [[X-7]], the other participants in the training program. However, after Soresh started [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] them with [[Torture/Legends|electrocution]], X-1, like the other trainees, had their personality and [[Brain/Legends|mind]] changed completely until they felt no emotions.<ref name="Target" /> Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the participants were pitted against each other in combat until only one remained. X-7 easily [[Death/Legends|killed]] X-1 and earned the right to become Soresh's personal assassin.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
X-1 first appeared in a flashback sequence in ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first book of the young readers series ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'', published in [[2008]] and written by [[Alex Wheeler]].<ref name="Target" />
